summary_table.subtitle: Inpatient oncology and immunotherapy episodes are emerging as a distinct cost driver

rows.bundled_ancillaries: Bundles flushes, admixtures, routine infusion supplies/administration, blood administration, and limits transfusion fees.
Same-day ancillaries bundle with room or facility fees, unless contracts or regulations require otherwise.
Always bundled codes are never separately reimbursed, regardless of modifiers, absent stated exceptions.
Not addressed; only 5-FU therapeutic monitoring covered, ancillary chemosensitivity and uracil tests excluded.
Only one initial administration daily; bill separate codes by parenteral method, including preparation/heparin flush.
Expected repetitive inpatient chemotherapy, transfusions, and dialysis are excluded from 31-day readmission review.
Routine or integral ancillary service components are bundled and not separately reimbursed.

reimbursement_policies.evidence: This policy is a broad pharmacy and infusion reimbursement policy, not a DRG-specific oncology policy. For inpatient and facility claims, infusion administration, routine supplies/equipment, blood transfusion administration, and related pharmacy services are generally bundled into the primary medical/surgical payment and are not separately reimbursed. Oncology and immunotherapy-related infusion services are handled through site-of-service rules rather than diagnosis-specific DRG rules.

prior_auth_thresholds: precertification required for home infusion therapy
provider_role_restrictions: health care professional in facility setting
exemptions: infusion/injection primary reason for facility visit
autologous donation in anticipation of scheduled surgery
patients under 1095 days of age for J7050

reimbursement_policies.evidence: The policy treats chemotherapy administration and infusion drug administration as bundled facility services when billed separately with a room or facility fee. For facility providers, separate reimbursement is denied on the same date of service.

This facility bundling policy applies to oncology infusion-related care in inpatient and outpatient facilities. Chemotherapy administration and infusion drug administration are generally not separately reimbursable when billed with a room or facility fee or another procedure, with stated state, provider, and contract exceptions.

state_specific_rules: Colorado chemo and infusion admin allowed
Washington chemo and infusion admin allowed
Kentucky chemo admin limited with treatment room
Wisconsin chemo and infusion admin allowed

reimbursement_policies.evidence: This policy is limited to 5-fluorouracil therapeutic drug monitoring under the lab benefit program and does not address DRG-based inpatient chemotherapy or immunotherapy episode reimbursement.

reimbursement_policies.policy_title: In Vitro Chemoresistance and Chemosensitivity Assays (LBM)
reimbursement_policies.evidence: No adjudication rule is stated for the requested inpatient oncology DRG pattern. This policy is limited to lab benefit coverage for in vitro chemoresistance and chemosensitivity assays and denies those assays as not meeting coverage criteria.
Off-topic for this policy. The policy addresses serum tumor marker laboratory coverage and does not include inpatient DRG payment or chemotherapy/immunotherapy episode bundling rules.
Point32Health reimburses chemotherapy injection administration revenue code 0331 when it is billed with the applicable CPT/HCPCS code and subject to general benefit and authorization rules.

utilization_limits: one initial administration service per day

reimbursement_policies.policy_title: Laboratory: Serum Tumor Markers for Malignancies
Laboratory: In Vitro Chemoresistance and Chemosensitivity Assays

reimbursement_policies.evidence: The policy is a general inpatient readmission policy. It generally combines related readmissions within 31 days into a single DRG payment, but explicitly excludes expected repetitive inpatient treatment such as cancer chemotherapy from the readmission-combination rule.

reimbursement_policies.policy_title: Inpatient Readmission Review Policy, Facility - Reimbursement Policy - UnitedHealthcare Commercial and Individual Exchange
reimbursement_policies.evidence: This inpatient readmission policy applies to same-facility same-day and 30-day planned readmission review, but it expressly excludes admissions for chemotherapy or immunotherapy treatment. Oncology/immunotherapy inpatient episodes are therefore exempt from this readmission bundling review.

exemptions: Admissions for chemotherapy or immunotherapy treatment
covered transplant services during global case rate period

reimbursement_policies.policy_title: Hospital Inclusive Charges Policy, Facility - Reimbursement Policy - UnitedHealthcare Commercial and Individual Exchange
reimbursement_policies.evidence: The policy does not identify this DRG label, but it applies general facility-inclusive billing rules to inpatient stays. Routine chemotherapy administration-related nursing services, IV therapy components, and floor-stock supplies are included in room and board or facility reimbursement and are not separately payable.

recommended_action.description:
Recommendation 1: Align Elevance facility policy to deny G0498 and 96521-96523 for a facility provider on the same date of service when billed with a room or facility fee or another procedure in Inpatient or Outpatient settings. Exempt: provider requirements, state requirements, federal contract requirements, provider, state, federal contract exceptions, Colorado chemo and infusion admin, Washington chemo and infusion admin, Kentucky treatment room same DOS, Wisconsin chemo and infusion admin. Peer: Cigna and UnitedHealth also use same date of service facility bundling, and both Elevance policies already target G0498 on the same date of service..

Recommendation 2: Adopt Cigna-style facility bundling for 96360-96379, 96401, 96402, 96409, 96411, 96413, 96415, 96416, 96417, and 96420 when billed on the same claim line and same date of service in a facility place of service on CMS-1500 or UB-04 by a health care professional in facility setting; require modifier JW, 59, SH, or SJ when a separately billable exception is claimed. Exempt: infusion/injection primary reason for facility visit. Peer: Elevance external/internal and UnitedHealth also use same date of service facility bundling, while Cigna applies that same-DOS edit directly to infusion and chemotherapy administration codes..

Recommendation 3: Allow J3490 and J9999 only on revenue codes 0331, 0332, 0335, or 0636 when billed by contracted providers with an applicable CPT/HCPCS code and NDC number, and limit to one initial administration service per day.

Recommendation 4: Bundle revenue codes 250, 260, 270-279, 300, 309, 361, 391, 410, 412, and 460 as hospital-inclusive charges during the same inpatient stay on UB04.
